profiles.alpha_detection: These semantic portraits consume alpha. After lossless uint8/uint16 PNG decode, use BC3 only when an alpha plane exists and any texel is below the dtype maximum. RGB and fully opaque RGBA use opaque BC1. Portraits whose shaders do not consume alpha remain in COLOR_RGB_BC1 and always discard source alpha.

profiles.channel_rule: Use for data read only from R, G or RG. Preserve the shader-visible component positions; unused stored components are deterministic zero.

profiles.alpha_detection: After lossless uint8/uint16 PNG decode, alpha is meaningful iff the image has an alpha plane and any texel differs from the dtype maximum. RGB and fully opaque RGBA select BC5U; otherwise select BC3.
